thread:
Alex Rivera: quick sync — Acme wants a short POC: document search + tool calling (create/invoice actions). Main ask: define success criteria, model fit, cost envelope. high-level Qs: context length, embeddings/re-rank strategy, SSO/KMS needs, and ballpark pricing for 10k queries/day.
Maria Chen: good. can we split success criteria into: precision@5 for QA, avg latency < 400ms for search path, successful end-to-end tool call in 95% of flows, and no PII leakage per sec.   :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: for model fit — recommend trying a 32k context variant for long docs. fallback to 8k if cost too high. use a two-stage approach: embeddings index (ANN) -> lightweight reranker (local/model with prompt) -> final generator for tool call formatting.
Katie L.: timeline? sales wants demo in 2 weeks. engineering needs 1 week to wire embeddings + index, 3 days for reranker tuning, 3 days for tool integration tests. seems tight.
Alex Rivera: ok put that as baseline timeline: Week1 ingest + embeddings, Week2 rerank & toolcall + acceptance. acceptance criteria: precision@5 >= 0.85 on our prompt set, avg token cost <= $0.003 per query, and integration smoke tests pass.
Maria Chen: security checklist from Acme: SSO + SCIM, bring-your-own-KMS, audit logs, monthly pen test report. they will send a security questionnaire by EOD.
Ben Ortiz: for embeddings size estimate: ~200k docs, average 3kb each -> expect index ~600M tokens. Use 768-d embeddings (or 1024-d depending on model) — we should run a small sample to estimate recall. Reranker can be a lighter FT or prompt-based with 8-16 shots.
Katie L.: pricing ask from customer: want committed pricing if we hit 10k q/day. propose: hosted default: $X per 1k queries + dedicated reserved capacity option for predictable SLAs. need numbers from finance.
Alex Rivera: @Maria can you draft the SOW with those acceptance criteria and the timeline? include fallback plan to 8k context model if we hit cost cap.
Maria Chen: on it. will include canary rollout plan and rollback on quality regressions. also adding a prompt-eval plan: we need 50 labeled test prompts across intents.
Ben Ortiz: technical clarifications for the POC engineer: sample curl for running semantic search + rerank:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/search \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"query":"What are the steps to dispute an entry?","top_k":50,"rerank":true}'
```
Katie L.: QA: who owns embeddings refresh cadence? customer wants daily updates for new docs. Ops needs to know retention and snapshot strategy.
InfraBot: deployment checklist created: ACME-POC-2124503021, infra ticket #INF-8793, service account created, KMS integration pending.
Alex Rivera: blockers: 1) security questionnaire turnaround, 2) finance pricing signoff, 3) model latency on 32k tests. we should surface these in the call tomorrow.
Maria Chen: I'll push security Q to them and ask for high priority. Katie, can you escalate pricing to finance?
Katie L.: will do. pinging @Finance. also adding an item to test quantized 8-bit variants to cut cost.
Ben Ortiz: last note on evals: let's create A/B prompt templates for reranker vs single-stage baseline. we'll collect precision/latency & token-cost metrics.
Alex Rivera: perfect. next sync tomorrow 11am PT. thanks folks. :rocket:
